data.description: Focusing divine power like a ray of the sun, you project a blast of light from your open palm. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack to strike your target. A creature struck by this ray of light takes 1d8 points of damage per two caster levels [maximum 5d8]. An undead creature takes 1d6 points of damage per caster level [maximum 10d6], and an undead creature particularly vulnerable to bright light takes 1d8 points of damage per caster level [maximum 10d8]. A construct or inanimate object takes only 1d6 points of damage per two caster levels [maximum 5d6].
